name: Individual Party A online signing
type: AM Platform / contracts / dual-party online signing
scope: Require a designated Party A LINE signer when the frozen Party A profile is individual
Expose a role-specific Party A signature field on the protected online signing page
Keep Party A and Party B signer identities distinct and bound to the authoritative contract group
Require both online signatures before individual Party A contract confirmation and final archival
Allow an active legacy signing session to bind its Party A signer without reissuing the frozen PDF

dataIsolation.guard: Each Party A signature is bound to one frozen document hash, signing session, designated LINE identity, and append-only evidence chain; no signature is written to a reusable profile.

definitionOfDone: Individual Party A issuance requires two different authorized LINE signers
Party A can sign the frozen contract through a dedicated role-specific online field
Party A cannot submit Party B data and non-signers cannot submit either role
Both signatures are required before confirmation and final archival
Company Party A behavior remains based on the frozen large company seal
Schema v8 accepts the new append-only Party A signing events
